title: Confirm one change end-to-end
objective: Measure whether one candidate improves the actual multi-GPU serving trace across its production KV-context mix.
preconditions: Pinned production topology and request trace
steps: Run baseline and candidate with identical request order, cache state, scheduler policy, topology, and warmup
Report incremental-prefill and decode separately plus weighted aggregate
Measure latency distribution, throughput, memory, graph recapture, communication, and concurrency
Use multiple balanced trials and retain raw request-level output

acceptance.pass: The declared service metric improves beyond uncertainty and no phase, tail, correctness, memory, or stability metric regresses.
acceptance.no_win: The region win is hidden by overlap, communication, scheduling, or a shifted critical path.

stop_rule: A single-card leaf result is never substituted for this experiment.
origin_evidence: Communication accounted for 52.5% of decode and 79.3% of 64k-prefill GPU time in the reviewed campaign.
